# A family of readings within what it reads

<!-- Generated by build_result_registry.py; edit the matching JSON record. -->

> A family of readings indexed by what it reads is complete exactly where nothing differs; completing it is an unfolding that never closes, never returns and is held by no finite stock; the liar is a rhythm with no still value.

`readings-within-what-they-read` · **recorded-checked** · theorem · F01

<a id="主张-claim"></a>
## Claim

Let ψ : A → A → B be a family of readings indexed by what it reads, and same the likeness of values. ψ says a reading g (Diagonal.Says same ψ g) when some a has ∀ x, same (ψ a x) (g x); the gap is gap f ψ x = f (ψ x x); f moves every value (Diagonal.Moves same f) when ∀ b, ¬ same b (f b). Where f moves every value no member says the gap (Diagonal.gap_unsaid); a ψ saying every reading gives every f a value b with same b (f b) (Diagonal.fixed_of_complete). A claim is never alike with its negation (Diagonal.moves_not), so no family of claims ψ : A → A → Prop says every reading (Diagonal.claims_incomplete, Diagonal.claims_gap), and no frame realizes with its own configurations every pattern of claims about them (Frame.self_incomplete). For values compared by equality: with equality to one value decided, a complete ψ makes all values equal (Diagonal.alike_of_complete); where all values are equal some ψ is complete (Diagonal.complete_of_alike); with equality of values decidable, completeness is exactly all values being equal (Diagonal.complete_iff_alike). φ : ℕ → A → A → B unfolds (Diagonal.Unfolds same f φ) when it keeps what it says and next says the step's gap; where f moves every value it is incomplete at every step (Diagonal.Unfolds.incomplete), the gap of step m + k is not said at step m (Diagonal.Unfolds.gap_new), with same transitive no two gaps are alike (Diagonal.Unfolds.gaps_differ), it never returns (Diagonal.Unfolds.never_returns), and with same symmetric and transitive no finite stock holds its gaps (Diagonal.stock_unheld, Diagonal.Unfolds.unheld). Such an unfolding exists on Bool (Diagonal.unfolding, Diagonal.unfolding_unfolds, Diagonal.unfolding_open). Revising a value by an f moving every value, Law.orbit f b (n + 1) ≠ Law.orbit f b n (Diagonal.revision_never_rests); revising a claim by negation never rests up to Iff (Diagonal.negation_never_rests); the two-valued negation returns every two steps (Diagonal.negation_returns). No Lean axiom is used.

Canonical source: [Diagonal.lean](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/becoming/Becoming/Diagonal.lean)

<a id="前提与对应-hypotheses-and-correspondence"></a>
## Hypotheses and correspondence

- No premise: gap_unsaid, claims_incomplete, the laws of Unfolds and the rhythm hold for every family, type of values and likeness.
- Local conditions are written into the theorems: alike_of_complete needs equality with one value decided, complete_iff_alike needs equality of values decidable, gaps_differ needs same transitive, stock_unheld needs it symmetric and transitive (deciding only on natural-number indices).
- The readings form a family indexed by what they read, a supplied reading; arithmetic coding and provability are not stated.

P71 (work board), following Ren's “push the frontier, as far as possible” of 12 October 2026. The periphery's RootCoverageBoundary (mathematical abstraction, CoverageBoundary.lean, importing Std) has the function and predicate forms of the same diagonal (fixed_point_of_complete, diagonal_extension_strict); here it is restated in the core with no axiom, with completeness exactly where nothing differs, the completing unfolding and the rhythm added. It tests the “from within” half of Ren's speculation: any given truth can be said at the next step, not all from one situation, and the limit is the projection's. P70 reads the negation's two states off revision_never_rests (Negation.two_states). Readings (the AI's, adopted on Ren's delegation; Ren agreed with the reply containing them): Zhuangzi's 一与言为二，二与一为三 has the regress form of Unfolds; a self-prediction announced into its loop has no still right value; the earlier reading of 道可道 as “说不尽” was the AI's, not Ren's. See §95 of the integration note.

## Validation and boundaries

14 October 2026: the current bytes of Becoming.Diagonal are bound to consolidated receipt 20261013T204910.042715Z (passed: 85 package modules, 4861 theorems, 6856 declaration audits, every source declaration with an empty axiom report; the 86-module core closure compiles from the prelude). Earlier receipts below checked the same statements under the former names, tabulated in plan section 10. Successful Lean 4.29.1 consolidated check (20261013T094743.528770Z): the 26 theorems of Becoming.Diagonal all have empty axiom reports, among them Diagonal.gap_unsaid, Diagonal.fixed_of_complete, Diagonal.claims_incomplete, Frame.self_incomplete, Diagonal.complete_iff_alike, Diagonal.Unfolds.incomplete, Diagonal.Unfolds.gaps_differ, Diagonal.Unfolds.never_returns, Diagonal.Unfolds.unheld, Diagonal.unfolding_open, Diagonal.revision_never_rests and Diagonal.negation_returns; the same receipt covers the package's 75 modules (including the import-only root and the bridge) with 4518 theorems/6370 declaration audits, and 22 inherited modules whose current bytes match passed receipts; periphery receipt 20261013T095049.338744Z passed. The checker also verifies core purity: the import closure of the core (GenerativeCore, InquirySufficiency, RelationalRenewal, L1–L4 and the root module Becoming) is exactly these 77 modules, every source declaration in it has an empty axiom report (of the constants Lean generates, only the injectivity lemmas of constructors with fields, injEq, depend on propext; no source declaration uses them, and the checker lists them), and it compiles from Lean's prelude alone (the foundation's import Std removed for that run). The author's counterreview is in §95 of the integration note, with the scope of the independent review.

The readings are indexed by what they read; Gödel's incompleteness and the halting problem are not stated; completeness exactly where nothing differs is for values compared by decidable equality, and for claims only incompleteness is stated; the rhythm is periodic only for the two-valued negation; the readings are the AI's; contains no ethical predicate.

- The unfolding on Bool (unfolding_open): incomplete at every step, never returning, its gaps held by no finite stock; revising the two-valued negation never rests (revision_never_rests, flip_moves).
